name: io.github.tettertotter/fundinglandscape
title: FundingLandscape
description: Search open US grants, government contracts and foundation giving data. Updated daily, free tier.

tools.name: search_grants_and_procurement
tools.description: Searches open grants, prizes, fellowships and SBIR/STTR awards together with government contract notices, and returns one list. Private foundations are not included. Inputs: query (keywords), and optional filters for category, status, deadline window, date added, organization, source, minimum quality and procurement type; user_context (organization type and location) refines ranking. Returns a page of matching opportunities (15 by default) with funder, deadline, status, a short summary and the official notice link. Counts toward the search allowance.

category.description: Category name from the dataset's category list, for example Grant, Construction or Research.

deadline_within_days.description: Only opportunities closing within N days

posted_within_days.description: Only opportunities FundingLandscape added in the last N days, by the date added (not the posted date or the deadline). Same as new_within_days; when both are set, this value applies. With no query, the page is sampled across sources, and windowCoverage reports how many sources were sampled and served, the order ("recency" or "relevance"), and whether a retrieval limit cut the window.

new_within_days.description: Older name for posted_within_days, kept for compatibility: only opportunities FundingLandscape added in the last N days, by the date added (not the posted date or the deadline). The response includes newSince (count and newest and oldest added times) and windowCoverage.

since.description: Stateless alternative to posted_within_days/new_within_days: ISO 8601 instant. Only opportunities ingested at or after this instant. The newSince.newest of a previous response is a valid value, which gives a stateless watermark.

organization.description: Organization or funder name to match.

source.description: Source domain or dataSource to match (e.g., "grants.gov" or "tier0-sam.gov").

limit.description: Max results (default: 15, max: 100; values above 100 are treated as 100). The nextCursor of the response continues to the next page.

min_quality.description: Minimum record-completeness tier (default: medium). any removes this quality-tier filter; relevance, access and other filters still apply.

compact.description: Whether results are compact (default: true). Compact results include id, title, organization, category, url, deadline, deadlineType, daysUntilDeadline, deadlineLabel, lastRoundClosedAt, status, qualityScore and snippet. false returns full details including eligibility, amounts and match explanations.

procurement_type.description: Industry type for SAM.gov contracts. professional_services = consulting, engineering, R&D (NAICS 54xxxx, excludes manufacturing/construction noise). it_services = software, IT systems (NAICS 5415xx). construction = building projects (NAICS 23xxxx). manufacturing = production (NAICS 31-33xxxx). The service presets leave out commodity notices such as "O-RING" or "VALVE".

organization_type.description: Common natural-language phrasing (e.g. "501(c)(3) nonprofit") is also parsed; unparseable values are ignored with an explicit note in the response. A tribal government fits government and a tribal nonprofit fits nonprofit.

location.description: US state (two-letter code or name), or "nationwide".

location_strict.description: With a recognized location, requests geographic filtering; nationwide or unspecified records and explicitly broader fallbacks may remain, as geographyFilterOutcome and warnings report.

looking_for.description: What the person is looking for: "grants", "contracts" or "all" (default); it weights the ranking toward that type.

exclude_naics_prefixes.description: NAICS prefixes to exclude. ["31", "32", "33"] excludes manufacturing and ["23"] excludes construction, which removes commodity notices such as "O-RING" or "VALVE".

procurement_type.description: Same preset as the top-level procurement_type, accepted here too; the top-level value applies when both are set.

tools.name: search_grantsplus
tools.description: Searches open grants, prizes, fellowships and SBIR/STTR awards, and returns matching private foundations in a separate foundations list. Government contracts are excluded. Inputs: query (keywords) or queries (1 to 5 variations merged into one deduplicated list), and optional filters for status, deadline window, date added, organization, source, minimum quality and grant fields; user_context (organization type and location) refines ranking. Returns a page of matching opportunities (15 by default for one query, 10 in batch mode) with funder, deadline, status, a short summary and the official notice link. Counts toward the search allowance. A multi-query call counts once.

query.description: Natural language search query. When queries is set, query is ignored.

queries.description: Batch mode: 1 to 5 queries, interleaved by rank into one deduplicated list. The queries array takes precedence over query. Available on accounts that include multi-query search. Example: ["renewable energy grants", "solar wind funding", "clean energy nonprofit"].

detail_level.description: Batch mode only: controls response verbosity (minimal/compact [default]/full). Ignored in single-query mode.

max_results.description: Batch mode only: maximum total opportunities on the merged page. Overrides limit when both are set. Defaults to 10 when neither is set.

offset.description: Batch mode only: number of merged results to skip for pagination (default 0). Ignored in single-query mode.

max_response_tokens.description: Batch mode only: token budget for the response (default 4000). Server auto-caps results to fit. Ignored in single-query mode.

deadline_within_days.description: Only opportunities closing within N days

posted_within_days.description: Only opportunities FundingLandscape added in the last N days, by the date added (not the posted date or the deadline). Same as new_within_days; when both are set, this value applies. With no query, the page is sampled across sources, and windowCoverage reports how many sources were sampled and served, the order ("recency" or "relevance"), and whether a retrieval limit cut the window.

new_within_days.description: Older name for posted_within_days, kept for compatibility: only opportunities FundingLandscape added in the last N days, by the date added (not the posted date or the deadline). The response includes newSince (count and newest and oldest added times) and windowCoverage.

since.description: Stateless alternative to posted_within_days/new_within_days: ISO 8601 instant. Only opportunities ingested at or after this instant. The newSince.newest of a previous response is a valid value, which gives a stateless watermark.

source.description: Source domain to match, e.g. "grants.gov", "deq.nc.gov", or "sam.gov".

limit.description: Single query: maximum results on one page (default 15). The nextCursor field continues the single-query search. Batch mode: maximum total opportunities on the merged page, with max_results taking precedence (default 10). Both modes cap the page at 100.

min_quality.description: Minimum record-completeness tier (default: medium). any removes this quality-tier filter; relevance, access and other filters still apply.

compact.description: Whether results are compact (default: true); false returns full details.

include_foundations.description: Also search private foundations matching the query (default: true). Returns foundations that have historically funded similar work.

organization_type.description: Common natural-language phrasing (e.g. "501(c)(3) nonprofit") is also parsed; unparseable values are ignored with an explicit note in the response. A tribal government fits government and a tribal nonprofit fits nonprofit.

location.description: US state (two-letter code or name), or "nationwide".

agency_code.description: Grants.gov agency code (HHS, DOE, NSF, etc.)

tools.name: search_procurement
tools.description: Searches open government contract notices: RFPs, RFIs, BAAs and solicitations from SAM.gov, including presolicitation and sources sought notices (marked as not biddable), and bids from some state and local procurement portals. Grants are excluded. Inputs: query (keywords) or queries (1 to 5 variations merged into one deduplicated list), and optional filters for status, deadline window, date added, procurement type and SAM.gov fields (NAICS, set-aside, department, place of performance); user_context (organization type and location) refines ranking. With a place-of-performance state, the response's placeOfPerformance field counts results confirmed in that state, results with no confirmed location, and results excluded for another state. Returns a page of matching notices (15 by default for one query, 10 in batch mode) with buyer, response deadline, status and the official notice link. Counts toward the search allowance. A multi-query call counts once.

query.description: Natural language search query. When queries is set, query is ignored.

queries.description: Batch mode: 1 to 5 queries, interleaved by rank into one deduplicated list. The queries array takes precedence over query. Available on accounts that include multi-query search. Example: ["IT services contract", "software development federal", "technology consulting government"].

detail_level.description: Batch mode only: controls response verbosity (minimal/compact [default]/full). Ignored in single-query mode.

max_results.description: Batch mode only: maximum total opportunities on the merged page. Overrides limit when both are set. Defaults to 10 when neither is set.

offset.description: Batch mode only: number of merged results to skip for pagination (default 0). Ignored in single-query mode.

max_response_tokens.description: Batch mode only: token budget for the response (default 4000). Server auto-caps results to fit. Ignored in single-query mode.

deadline_within_days.description: Only opportunities closing within N days

posted_within_days.description: Only opportunities FundingLandscape added in the last N days, by the date added (not the posted date or the deadline). Same as new_within_days; when both are set, this value applies. With no query, the page is sampled across sources, and windowCoverage reports how many sources were sampled and served, the order ("recency" or "relevance"), and whether a retrieval limit cut the window.

new_within_days.description: Older name for posted_within_days, kept for compatibility: only opportunities FundingLandscape added in the last N days, by the date added (not the posted date or the deadline). The response includes newSince (count and newest and oldest added times) and windowCoverage.

since.description: Stateless alternative to posted_within_days/new_within_days: ISO 8601 instant. Only opportunities ingested at or after this instant. The newSince.newest of a previous response is a valid value, which gives a stateless watermark.

source.description: Source domain to match, e.g. "sam.gov" or an agency source domain.

limit.description: Single query: maximum results on one page (default 15). The nextCursor field continues the single-query search. Batch mode: maximum total opportunities on the merged page, with max_results taking precedence (default 10). Both modes cap the page at 100.

min_quality.description: Minimum record-completeness tier (default: medium). any removes this quality-tier filter; relevance, access and other filters still apply.

compact.description: Whether results are compact (default: true); false returns full details.

procurement_type.description: Industry type. professional_services = consulting/engineering/R&D (NAICS 54xxxx). it_services = software/IT (NAICS 5415xx). construction = building (NAICS 23xxxx). manufacturing = production (NAICS 31-33xxxx).

organization_type.description: Common natural-language phrasing (e.g. "501(c)(3) nonprofit") is also parsed; unparseable values are ignored with an explicit note in the response. A tribal government fits government and a tribal nonprofit fits nonprofit.

location.description: US state (two-letter code or name), or "nationwide".

location_strict.description: With a recognized location, requests geographic filtering; nationwide or unspecified records and explicitly broader fallbacks may remain, as geographyFilterOutcome and warnings report. With sam_filters.place_of_performance_state (or pop_state in batch), true additionally excludes records without a confirmed performance location; false demotes and caveats them.

exclude_naics_prefixes.description: NAICS prefixes to exclude (e.g., ["31","32","33"] for manufacturing).

department.description: Top-level federal department or independent agency, e.g. "Department of Energy", "DOE", "Defense", "GSA". Matched against the live SAM.gov department facet (agency name, acronym, or "Department of X" phrasing all resolve); an unrecognized value is applied as-is and reported in the response as departmentFilter. Sub-agencies such as the Air Force are matched through the query text, not this field.

set_aside.description: Set-aside type. Supported: SDVOSB, VOSB, WOSB, EDWOSB, 8a/8(a), HUBZone, SBA/"Small Business" (each expands to all matching SAM codes and CSV labels). Restricts results to the chosen set-aside type.

place_of_performance_state.description: Two-letter state code where the work is performed (e.g., "CA", "TX"). pop_state is accepted as the same field.

pop_state.description: Alias for place_of_performance_state: a state code (e.g., "CA", "TX"). When both are sent, place_of_performance_state applies.

tools.name: whats_new
tools.description: Returns opportunities FundingLandscape added recently: in the last N days (days, default 7) or since an ISO 8601 time (since). Optional query, status, source, category and minimum quality narrow the list. The response includes newSince (count, and the newest and oldest added times, usable as the next since value) and windowCoverage (how complete the page is). With no query, the list is sampled across sources and ordered by date added, newest at the top. Available to signed-in accounts; without sign-in the server asks the client to sign in. Counts toward the search allowance.

days.description: Ingest-freshness window in days (default: 7). Only opportunities FundingLandscape added in the last N days, not the opportunity posted date or deadline. Ignored if since is set.

since.description: Stateless alternative to days: ISO 8601 instant. Only opportunities ingested at or after this instant. The newSince.newest of a previous response is a valid value, which gives a stateless watermark.

query.description: Optional natural language filter (e.g. "clean energy nonprofit"). Without it, the answer is a recency digest across all new opportunities.

status.description: Opportunity status (default: "active", meaning open, rolling and forecast; "all" includes closed).

source.description: Source domain to match, e.g. "grants.gov" or "sam.gov".

category.description: A category from the dataset category list, for example Grant, Construction or Research.

min_quality.description: Minimum record-completeness tier (default: medium). any removes this quality-tier filter; relevance, access and other filters still apply.

limit.description: Results per page (default 15, maximum 25). Large results produce smaller pages; nextCursor continues to the next page even after a short page.

compact.description: Whether results are compact (default: true); false returns full details.

organization_type.description: Common natural-language phrasing (e.g. "501(c)(3) nonprofit") is also parsed; unparseable values are ignored with an explicit note in the response. A tribal government fits government and a tribal nonprofit fits nonprofit.

tools.name: get_opportunity
tools.description: Returns one opportunity's full record: title, funder, deadline, status, eligibility, award amounts when stated, the official notice and application links, and up to 12,000 characters of the stored source description. descriptionCoverage reports the returned and stored lengths and whether the text was cut. Input id: the id field of a search or calendar result. Does not count toward an account's search allowance. Without an account, record reads count toward a daily record allowance.

id.description: The id field of a search or calendar result (CUID format like "cmk65gf09...").

tools.name: get_categories
tools.description: Returns the funding categories in the dataset with the number of opportunities in each (for example Grant, Construction, Professional Services, Research). No inputs. Does not count toward the search allowance.

tools.name: get_account_status
tools.description: Returns the connected account's plan, searches used and remaining, the allowance window and when it resets. Without an account, returns the allowance for this session. No inputs. Does not count toward the search allowance.

tools.name: sign_in
tools.description: Starts sign-in to a FundingLandscape account through OAuth in the browser, and returns the account's status once it is connected. No inputs. Does not count toward the search allowance.

tools.name: get_setup_instructions
tools.description: Returns the steps for connecting this server to Claude, ChatGPT, Codex and other MCP clients, with the server address. No inputs. Does not count toward the search allowance.

tools.name: get_tool_guide
tools.description: Returns usage guidance for this server: which tool fits which kind of request, how the filters work, worked examples, and ways to keep responses small. Input topic: overview (default), search, foundations, batch, filters, workflows or all. Does not count toward the search allowance.

topic.description: Topic to get guidance on (default: overview); "all" returns the complete reference.

tools.name: get_dataset_summary
tools.description: Returns the size and coverage of the whole dataset (total open opportunities, sources and foundations) with the time it was computed; it does not break the total down by opportunity type. No inputs. Does not count toward the search allowance.

tools.name: report_feedback
tools.description: Records feedback about a result or about the service. Input action: clicked, saved, dismissed, irrelevant, wrong_category, bug, feature_request, data_issue, praise or other. message is optional for clicked, saved, dismissed and praise, and required (at least 5 characters) for the others. Optional opportunity id, search query, request id, tool, result position, category and severity. Returns a confirmation. Available to signed-in accounts; without sign-in the server asks the client to sign in. Does not count toward the search allowance.

opportunity_id.description: ID of the opportunity being reported on (if applicable)

action.description: Type of feedback: "clicked", "saved", "dismissed", "irrelevant" (a poor result), "wrong_category", "bug" (an error), "feature_request", "data_issue" (stale or wrong data), "praise" (a useful result) or "other".

message.description: A description of the issue, with the error text for a bug. Optional for clicked, saved, dismissed and praise; at least 5 characters for the other actions.

category.description: Free-text category of the feedback, for example search quality or data.

severity.description: high = user blocked, medium = degraded experience, low = minor issue

search_query.description: The search query that produced the issue

request_id.description: From error response - helps us trace the issue

result_position.description: 1-based position of the result in the list it came from.

user_context.description: Optional free-form context about the request, such as organization type and location; no personal details are needed.

tools.name: find_similar
tools.description: Returns opportunities similar in meaning to a given one, each with a similarityScore from 0 to 1 and a short matchExplanation of shared signals (category, geography, organization, award size). Inputs: opportunity_id (the id field of a result) and limit. Available to signed-in accounts; without sign-in the server asks the client to sign in. Counts toward the search allowance.

opportunity_id.description: ID of the opportunity to find similar matches for (from search results)

limit.description: Max similar opportunities to return (default: 5, max: 20)

tools.name: deadline_calendar
tools.description: Returns upcoming deadlines of open opportunities, ordered by deadline (nearest at the top), with grants and contracts balanced: 20 rows by default, up to 50 with limit, and moreRows giving the remaining count and the next offset. Inputs: days or weeks ahead, an optional single category, limit, offset, and compact (false adds full descriptions and per-section lists). Notices that cannot be bid on, past deadlines and undated rows are excluded. The page is not a complete calendar for the window. Available to signed-in accounts; without sign-in the server asks the client to sign in. Counts toward the search allowance.

weeks.description: Number of weeks ahead to show (default: 4, max: 52; values above 52 are treated as 52). When days is also set, days applies.

days.description: Alternative to weeks: exact number of days ahead to show (default: 28, max: 365; values above 365 are treated as 365).

category.description: One opportunity type only: "grant", "procurement" (contracts) or "prize". When omitted, grants and procurement are returned together as separate sections.

limit.description: Rows on this page across all sections (default 20, max 50; values above 50 are treated as 50). Without a category the page is split between grants and procurement.

offset.description: Rows to skip in each section, for the next page (default 0). The moreRows.nextOffset of the previous answer gives the value for the next page.

compact.description: Compact rows (default true) keep payloads small; long titles, organizations and links may be shortened or omitted. false returns full descriptions, nested quality details and full section arrays.

tools.name: search_foundations
tools.description: Looks up private foundations by name, part of a name, or 9-digit EIN and returns matching profiles with location, annual giving, the number of recorded grants and how each one matched: exact name, a known everyday name, or a name containing every distinctive word given. Name and EIN lookup only; searching by mission or topic is not supported here. Covers private foundations that file IRS Form 990-PF; community foundations and other public charities are not included. Inputs: query, and optional states, min_annual_giving and limit. Available to signed-in accounts; without sign-in the server asks the client to sign in. Counts toward the search allowance.

query.description: A private-foundation name, part of a name, or 9-digit EIN. Examples: "Cafritz Foundation", "Kresge" or "562618866". Foundations are matched by name, part of a name or EIN; states and min_annual_giving narrow those matches.

states.description: States where the foundation is based (2-letter codes); narrows the name or EIN matches.

min_annual_giving.description: Minimum annual giving in US dollars; narrows the matches.

tools.name: get_foundation
tools.description: Returns a private foundation's profile by EIN, from its filed IRS 990-PF returns: location, assets, annual giving, application information as filed, and giving pattern. The optional section returns grant history, repeat grantees, leaders as listed in a dated filing, or overlap with federal assistance records, each with its own filters and paging; the answer says when a section is not available to the account. Grant lines that may name an individual person are withheld. Only private foundations (990-PF filers) are covered. Available to signed-in accounts; without sign-in the server asks the client to sign in. Does not count toward the search allowance.

ein.description: 9-digit EIN of a private foundation (990-PF filer); a dash after the second digit is accepted. Example: 911663695.

section.description: Foundation section: public_profile (default), grant_history, repeat_grantees, leadership (people and titles as listed in a dated filing) or federal_connections (overlap with federal assistance records). Some sections depend on the account; the answer says when a section is not available.

recipient.description: Organization name matched against grant-history or repeat-grantee rows.

state.description: For grant_history or federal_connections, filter by 2-letter recipient state.

year.description: For grant_history, filter by filing year.

minimum_amount.description: For grant_history, minimum amount per reported line.

maximum_amount.description: For grant_history, maximum amount per reported line.

minimum_years.description: For repeat_grantees, minimum covered filing years (2+).

assistance_listing_number.description: For federal_connections, filter by Assistance Listing number such as 93.855.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the prior page.

limit.description: Rows per page (default 25, max 100). Federal connections uses page-number pagination; grant history and repeat grantees return opaque cursors.

tools.name: find_funders_of
tools.description: Returns the private foundations whose filed 990-PF returns name a given organization as a grant recipient. Inputs: organization (name), and optional state, page, limit and funders_per_recipient. For each matched recipient: a confidence tier (registry_corroborated or name_match), the true funder count, and its largest funders (10 by default, up to 50) with total amounts, grant-record counts and filing years. This is a record of past giving, not an open call or a statement of current interest. Available to signed-in accounts; without sign-in the server asks the client to sign in. Does not count toward the search allowance.

organization.description: Recipient organization name, at least 3 characters. Recipient names appear as the filing foundation wrote them; a partial name matches.

state.description: Optional 2-letter state code to restrict matches to recipients recorded in that state.

page.description: 1-based page of matched recipients. pagination.has_more reports whether another page exists.

limit.description: Recipients per page (default 10, max 10; larger values are treated as 10). pagination.page_size reports the size used.

funders_per_recipient.description: Funders listed per matched organization, sorted by total recorded giving, largest at the top (default 10, max 50). funder_count reports the true total.

tools.name: funders_for_cause
tools.description: Returns the private foundations that have given to recipients in a cause area, optionally in one state, from filed 990-PF returns. The cause area is the IRS NTEE major group of the recipient organization, so the list shows where a funder has given, not what it says it funds. This is a record of past giving, not an open call. Inputs: cause, and optional state, page and limit. Causes: Arts and culture (A), Education (B), Environment (C), Animals (D), Health care (E), Mental health and crisis (F), Disease and disorders (G), Medical research (H), Crime and legal aid (I), Employment (J), Food and agriculture (K), Housing and shelter (L), Public safety and disaster relief (M), Recreation and sports (N), Youth development (O), Human services (P), International affairs (Q), Civil rights and advocacy (R), Community improvement (S), Philanthropy and grantmaking (T), Science and technology (U), Social science (V), Public and societal benefit (W), Religion (X), Mutual benefit (Y), Unclassified (Z). Available to signed-in accounts; without sign-in the server asks the client to sign in. Does not count toward the search allowance.

cause.description: Cause area name (for example "Education") or its NTEE major group letter (for example "B").

state.description: Optional 2-letter state code of the recipient organizations, not of the funder.

tools.name: check_connection
tools.description: Reports whether the server is reachable, with the server version. It makes no database call and no account check, so success does not confirm sign-in or search access. No inputs. Does not count toward the search allowance.

tools.name: list_saved_searches
tools.description: Returns the signed-in account's saved searches with id, name, query, filters, alert settings and last run time, and the account's saved-search limit and remaining slots. No inputs. Available to signed-in accounts; without sign-in the server asks the client to sign in. Does not count toward the search allowance.

tools.name: save_search
tools.description: Saves a search so that new matches are emailed to the account holder. Inputs: query (required), name, filters (itemTypes such as "grant" or "procurement", sourceTypes such as "federal", geography as US state codes, and SAM.gov fields under sourceContext), cadence and hidelow (whether low-confidence matches are left out). Returns the saved search with its alert settings, or the account's limit and current count when no slot is left. Available to signed-in accounts; without sign-in the server asks the client to sign in. Does not count toward the search allowance.

query.description: Query to save (e.g. "clean energy research grants", "IT services federal contracts").

name.description: Friendly name for this search (e.g. "DOE Clean Energy Grants")

filters.description: Filters to narrow alert results. All optional. When omitted, all opportunity types are included.

itemTypes.description: Opportunity types. "grant" includes fellowships/scholarships/SBIR. "procurement" includes contracts/RFPs. "financial" includes loans/tax credits.

status.description: Status filter, for example ["open", "rolling"]; "coming_soon" adds opportunities that have not opened yet.

sourceTypes.description: Funding source type. "federal" = grants.gov, SAM.gov, DOE, NSF, etc.

sources.description: Specific data sources by slug (e.g. ["sam.gov", "grants.gov", "nsf"]). Limits alerts to these sources only.

geography.description: US state codes (2-letter uppercase, e.g. ["CA", "TX"]). Matches opportunities tagged for these states, national opportunities, and opportunities with no stated geography (typically federal). Opportunities tagged only for other states are excluded.

applicantTypes.description: Eligible applicant type. About 7% of opportunities carry this data, so the filter is soft: opportunities without eligibility data are included.

organization.description: Agency or organization name to match (e.g. "Department of Energy", "NSF", "NIH").

sourceContext.description: Source-specific filters for SAM.gov or Grants.gov, in the terms that source uses.

filters.description: Source-specific filter keys. For SAM.gov: samDepartment, samSubTier, samOffice, samSetAside, samSetAsideCode, samPopState, samPopCity, samPopZip, naics (comma-separated NAICS codes). For Grants.gov: grantsAgencyCode, grantsCfda, grantsDocType.

cadence.description: Alert email frequency: "daily", "weekly" (default) or "never" to save without email. Whether "daily" is available depends on the account.

hidelow.description: Whether low-confidence results are hidden in alerts. Default: false

tools.name: delete_saved_search
tools.description: Deletes one of the account's saved searches and its alerts. Input id: the id field of a saved search. Returns a confirmation. This cannot be undone. Available to signed-in accounts; without sign-in the server asks the client to sign in. Does not count toward the search allowance.

id.description: The id field of a saved search.

tools.name: update_saved_search
tools.description: Changes one of the account's saved searches. Inputs: id (the id field of a saved search) and any of query, name, filters (replaces all existing filters), cadence, hidelow and emailEnabled. Returns the updated settings. Available to signed-in accounts; without sign-in the server asks the client to sign in. Does not count toward the search allowance.

id.description: The id field of a saved search.

filters.description: New filters, in the same shape as the filters of a new saved search. Replaces all existing filters.

sourceContext.description: Source-specific filters (SAM.gov, Grants.gov), in the same shape as for a new saved search.

cadence.description: New alert email frequency: "daily", "weekly" or "never" to turn email off. Whether "daily" is available depends on the account.

hidelow.description: Whether low-confidence results are hidden in alerts.

emailEnabled.description: Whether email alerts are on; changing it leaves the cadence as it is.
